item.text:
Fixed the GFM inline lexer so explicit autolinks are skipped while it is inside a link. Bare GFM URLs were already guarded; this closes the same gap for URL and email autolinks. The change is in [Lexer.ts](/C:/Users/USER/Downloads/agent-test/limit/codex_t6t2_r2/work/src/Lexer.ts).

I didn’t run tests, per your instructions.
